logical_record: Complex C^2, |0>,|1>, normalized preparations, bilinear evolution replaced here by the usual Hermitian quantum-state/instrument convention.
optical_space: vacuum plus single excitation in two supplied orthogonal modes a,b; basis (vac,10,01)
scale: Positive symbolic Omega; t_model=Omega*t_physical. No numerical physical clock/energy calibration supplied.
inactive_generator: hbar Omega b†b; same record gap, coupling disabled
logical_generator: [[0,-1/2],[-1/2,1]] in active sector; [[0,0],[0,1]] in inactive sector
positive_optical_carrier_offset: May add hbar nu N_total with nu>=Omega*(sqrt(2)-1)/2; retain this actual free-resource term. It is a common phase only on fixed N_total=1, not on vacuum/coherent number superpositions.
queries: Encoded I,X,Y,Z, including record occupation n=(I-Z)/2; optical vacuum is a separate flag and all outcomes retained.
loss: Equal-mode pure loss with transmissivity eta in [0,1]: erasure into retained vacuum branch. Loss does not produce logical |0> and is not logical reset.
unmatched: Physical controlled coupling by Pi versus c-Pi
Named apparatus and calibrated coupling/detuning/phase frame
